page.notes: Marginal notes a, b, c, d are on the left. Note a is partly unclear: "Aduerf. tu-de. prob. mu." is read as "Adversus Tertullianum de probatione mulierum" in the scan, but the abbreviations are not fully legible. "Torto" in the body text may be a misreading of a name, and "tantetur" and "vt reges sit" are doubtful. The first line is a fragment of a sentence continued from the previous page. The text ends mid-sentence with "Augustinus," and continues on the next page. No catchword or signature is printed.
